> **Monorepo Path Architecture (`NSE_ROOT`)**: This repository uses a mirrored `code/` and `data/` directory structure rooted at the **`NSE_ROOT`** environment variable. All source code resides under `$NSE_ROOT/code/<ENGINE>` and all runtime artifacts (logs, SQLite/DuckDB databases, Parquet datasets, trained ML models, and generated reports) reside in the mirrored `$NSE_ROOT/data/<ENGINE>` directory.

# Configuration reference

Settings come from `config.py` defaults, overridden by `config/system.yaml`; `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}`
are filled from the environment (`.env`). This table lists each setting's default, the value shipped in
`system.yaml`, and the explanation written next to it there.

Sections: [`capital`](#capital) · [`paths`](#paths) · [`broker`](#broker) · [`session`](#session) · [`risk`](#risk) · [`oms`](#oms) · [`costs`](#costs) · [`paper`](#paper) · [`regime`](#regime) · [`crowding`](#crowding) · [`gates`](#gates) · [`compute`](#compute) · [`monitor`](#monitor) · [`journal`](#journal) · [`book`](#book) · [`feeds`](#feeds) · [`system`](#system) · [`fragility`](#fragility) · [`parallel`](#parallel) · [`notifier`](#notifier) · [`strategies`](#strategies)

| `fragility.action` | `report` | `report` | report (log only) \| halve (new swing entries) \| block (no new swing entries) |
| `fragility.min_names` | `10` |  |  |

## parallel

multi-core execution: see docs/03-architecture/PERFORMANCE.md, `nsealgo hardware`, `nsealgo bench`

| Setting | Default | In system.yaml | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parallel.workers` | `auto` | `auto` | auto = one process per physical core (RAM-capped); or a number, e.g. 32 for SMT |
| `parallel.use_smt` | `false` | `false` | true = one process per hardware thread (measure with `nsealgo bench` first) |
| `parallel.split` | `auto` | `auto` | auto = strategy sleeves x period blocks \| strategy \| none |
| `parallel.warmup_sessions` | `120` | `120` | swing blocks start early so positions/state match a continuous run... |
| `parallel.runoff_sessions` | `90` | `90` | ...and run on without new entries until their trades finish |
| `parallel.min_block_daily` | `250` | `250` | smallest period block for swing sleeves (larger = less warm-up overhead) |
| `parallel.min_block_minute` | `1` |  |  |
| `parallel.io_threads` | `auto` |  |  |
| `parallel.history_threads` | `4` | `4` | parallel history downloads (the broker's rate limit still paces requests) |
